# `openai_chat_completions_to_anthropic_stream`

Converts the selected Anthropic provider's event stream incrementally. OpenAI-compatible candidates are left byte-for-byte unchanged.

## Configuration Notes

Place this after `intelligent_route` and before the request converter. The filter binds to the immutable provider profile saved by the request converter and retains only a partial SSE event plus bounded tool indexes.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `max_partial_event_bytes` | integer | yes | Maximum incomplete event bytes retained across response chunks. |
| `max_tool_blocks` | integer | yes | Maximum Anthropic tool blocks retained for one response. |
